title: Diatomaceous earth with puffer tip
text: Diatomaceous earth with puffer tip. I purchase this every so often to use as non chemical bug repel. Dries up insects instantly and most spiders too.  The puffer tip helps some with application, but lets face it - it's a fine, fine powder and it's just mess no matter what.  Do wear a mask when you are applying it to be sure you don't inhale it.  It's not poisonous, but it's not good to inhale even a little bit of it.  No odor.
